description: Hold pnpm on v10: Vercel builds with package.json#packageManager, and Vercel only documents pnpm 6-10 (https://vercel.com/docs/package-managers).

pnpm 11+ is unsupported there (https://github.com/vercel/vercel/issues/17434). Remove this rule once Vercel lists pnpm 11+; migration steps are in the closing comment of https://github.com/samjmarshall/personal-finance/pull/30.
